|rulings=* Read this as owner's move phase and ''any'' exterior sites (not as owner's move phase and ''owner's'' exterior sites).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Insurrection%20%26%20%E2%80%A2Aim%20High</ref>
* For Nabrun and Elis, the origin site and the destination site must ''both'' be exterior (interior/exterior sites such as [[Death Star (Special Edition){{!}}Death Star]]: [[Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] are allowed).
* Dark has the option to decline and cancel the retrieval.
* The amount of Force used ('X') equals the retrieval amount initiated, even if the Lost pile has fewer than X cards.
* If Dark is to search their Lost Pile to retrieve card(s) that meet specific criteria, Dark searches first, then pays for [[Aim High]] only if they find valid card(s) and choose to retrieve.
